_note: Fallback for hosts without directory listings (e.g. GitHub Pages). Local `python3 -m http.server` serving the parent folder lists .pgn files automatically and takes priority over this file. When you drop new .pgn files here and deploy to the static host, add the filename (without .pgn) to this list: {"collections":["Name A","Name B"]}. Password-protected collections: generate <name>.pgn.enc from a plaintext source with `make encrypt IN=<pgn> OUT=files/collections/<name>.pgn.enc PASSWORD=...` and add <name> to "encrypted" (keep plaintext sources in gitignored local-pgn/, never in this folder).
